question_text: A 35-year-old patient with no significant past medical history arrives to the ED with abdominal cramps, nausea, and vomiting. He has had no recent travel or chemical exposures; however, three other members of his family also arrived concurrently to the ED with abdominal cramps, nausea, and vomiting. When asked about their recent activities, they recall that they had shared a lunch of leftover fried rice and soft boiled eggs about 5 hours earlier. The patients are otherwise afebrile and deny any history of diarrhea. Which of the following toxins is the most likely to have caused these symptoms?
